currentReviewPath.surface: installed Android internal IGS upload-render preview
currentReviewPath.expectedResult: local 3D preview with dimensions, grid, zoom and orientation controls

markApprovalRequiredFor: claims that the CAD preview is externally validated

minimumFields: screenshot or short clip when possible

triageClasses.defaultAction: confirm APK install path, relaunch/update state and installed-app bundle before changing source
capture Android picker/device details and reproduce with public or synthetic file before changing backend gates
treat as local renderer/file compatibility issue; do not infer backend upload or conversion failure
route to source/fixture interpretation review and keep external validation claims blocked
answer from remaining-gates list; do not imply production activation or commercialization readiness

responseRules: do not ask Mark for private CAD in this review path
do not request production credentials or account enrollment
do not claim a backend upload, conversion or Sandbox failure from a local preview symptom
preserve direct recipient details as local/email evidence references rather than source text

markApprovalNotRequiredFor: public preview hardening that preserves current disabled gates
upload/session UX clarity while upload admission remains disabled
feedback intake and triage packet updates
internal tester diagnostics and support-readiness updates

parallelWorkAllowed.description: Keep the public-material preview usable and clear while Mark reviews it.
Improve disabled upload/session language and recovery paths without activating uploads.
Prepare per-CAD-run cost breakdown planning across Convex, Vercel, Sandbox, storage, compute and contingency.
Prepare the next Build-phase surface while keeping manufacturing output locked.
Prepare Mark response handling, issue classification and follow-up boundaries without contacting Mark again.
Prepare support diagnostics for installed-app internal IGS preview issues before Mark responds.

hardStops: provider/auth/resource/env changes outside the approved development target
new paid commitments at or above the approved cap
external messages beyond the already approved Mark handoff
claims that Mark approved geometry before his response is received
nextRecommendedGate: source-only internal tester diagnostics and support-readiness packet
